Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (302 points, ~1% of the sample). The series crosses zero, so percentage errors are unstable and mean-based combinations are safer than ratio-based ones. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.223), which favours a robust combination.
